verdict.rationale: Docs say CodeRabbit reviews catch security vulnerabilities alongside race conditions, memory leaks, runtime errors and logic flaws. The pricing page lists linter and SAST tool support, and path instructions can add targeted security checks. A hands-on HN report confirms it flagged a critical security risk on a malicious PR. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of injection-risk and leaked-secret detection within the PR diff itself (secret scanning is only documented for the separately metered AI Deep Scan, which covers code beyond the diff), and independent evidence on security-finding accuracy or false-positive rates.
